# ADR-3218: AWS network: VPC flow logs required key for VPC 2

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Without flow logs, lateral movement is hard to see.

## Decision

Network baselines SHALL include a VPC flow logs required key for VPC 2 (AWS-network-2).

## Consequences

Logs land in immutable accounts.
